subject: general
question: How many Nobel Prize award categories are present?
solution: There are six categories of prizes, out of which all are given each year. There are six eligible prizes every year. They are awarded for Outstanding contributions for humanity in __**chemistry, economics, literature, peace, physics, Physiology or Medicine.**__
